fusions.name: Crossed Strands
fusions.desc: Throws a net of crossing strands in a cone, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Blunted], lowering the target's critical chance for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Palmed Purse
fusions.desc: A sly cast that deals 30 damage and strips 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Veiled Tie
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Marked Cards
fusions.desc: After a run of strikes without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 50% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
